question: Which of the following is a key responsibility of IRDAI?

options.text: Protecting the interests of insurance policyholders
Managing disinvestment in public sector enterprises

solution:
The correct answer is __**Protecting the interests of insurance policyholders**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) is the statutory body responsible for regulating and promoting the insurance sector in India.
 
• A key function of IRDAI is to protect the interests of policyholders by ensuring fair treatment and transparency in the insurance process.
 
• IRDAI mandates insurance companies to adhere to guidelines for policy issuance, claim settlement, and grievance redressal.
 
• The body ensures that insurers maintain solvency margins, safeguarding policyholders' funds from potential financial risks faced by insurance companies.
 
• IRDAI promotes consumer education and awareness to help policyholders make informed decisions about insurance products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IRDAI:** Established under the IRDA Act, 1999, IRDAI is headquartered in Hyderabad and functions as an autonomous authority to regulate the insurance industry in India.
 
• **Policyholder Protection Committee:** IRDAI has constituted this committee to address consumer grievances and ensure fair practices by insurers.
 
• **Solvency Margin:** It is the minimum capital insurers are required to maintain to reduce the risk of insolvency and protect policyholders' interests.
 
• **Grievance Redressal:** IRDAI launched the Integrated Grievance Management System (IGMS) to facilitate policyholders in lodging and tracking complaints against insurers.
 
• **Other Responsibilities of IRDAI:** Includes licensing insurers and intermediaries, promoting competition, and ensuring the growth of the insurance market in India.
